note: Numbers are append-only. Never renumber or reuse a number; retire an entry with "retired": true and take next_number for new entries. stack = most per inventory slot. kind: material, tool, weapon, placeable. Numbers in 'tool' and 'weapon' are placeholders until skills exist. look_alikes feed inspection mode. durability = uses a tool lasts; wear is kept per inventory slot (server-owned). repair = materials one repair spends; a repair wins back half the durability. value = placeholder price of one item in coins (inventory sort; items without one count as 2). description: one plain line shown in the tooltip (job 75).

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: A fist-sized stone, picked up from the ground or broken from an outcrop.

stick.name: Stick
stick.description: A fallen branch, good for fuel and for tools.

plant_fibre.name: Plant fibre
plant_fibre.description: Stringy plant fibre that can be twisted into twine or used as tinder.

log.name: Log
log.description: A heavy length of trunk. Split it into firewood or saw it into lumber.

cordage.name: Cordage
cordage.description: Twisted plant fibre, strong enough to bind a tool or weave a chest.

stone_axe.name: Stone axe
stone_axe.description: A sharpened stone bound to a handle. Fells trees, breaks rock and cuts wood.

spear.name: Stone spear
spear.description: A stone point bound to a long shaft, for jabbing and throwing.

campfire_kit.name: Campfire
campfire_kit.description: Stones and sticks ready to lay a fire where you stand.

wooden_spear.name: Wooden spear
wooden_spear.description: A sharpened stick, for jabbing and throwing.

stone_knife.name: Stone knife
stone_knife.description: A sharp stone flake on a handle. Cuts bark, gum and sap.

torch.name: Basic torch
torch.description: A stick wrapped in fibre that burns for a while and lights your way.

bark.name: Bark
bark.description: Bark stripped from a felled trunk.

roast_forage.name: Roasted forage
roast_forage.description: Foraged food cooked over a fire.

seed_bundle.name: Seeds
seed_bundle.description: A small bundle of seeds that could be eaten or planted.

poultice.name: Herb poultice
poultice.description: Crushed herb leaves for a wound.

bandage.name: Herb bandage
bandage.description: Leaves and fibre wrapped to bind a wound.
bandage.note: Placeholder: stops bleeding once health exists.

tree_roots.name: Roots
tree_roots.description: Roots from the base of a felled tree.

wooden_spade.name: Wooden spade
wooden_spade.description: A sharpened wooden blade on a handle. Digs roots and bulbs.

lean_to_kit.name: Small shelter
lean_to_kit.description: Sticks, leaves and twine for a small shelter with a roof.

lean_to.name: Small shelter
lean_to.description: A small shelter. Its roof keeps rain off.

chest_kit.name: Woven chest
chest_kit.description: Sticks and twine woven into a storage chest, ready to set down.

chest.name: Woven chest
chest.description: A woven chest for storing things.
chest.note: First chest: woven twine and sticks (no boards without a sawmill). A plank chest (more slots, wood) comes after the saw mill under its own id.

chopping_block_kit.name: Chopping block
chopping_block_kit.description: A log set on end to split wood on, ready to set down.

chopping_block.name: Chopping block
chopping_block.description: A chopping block. Split logs into firewood here.

driftwood.name: Driftwood
driftwood.description: A bleached branch washed up on a bank. Dry, so it burns well.

firewood.name: Firewood
firewood.description: Split wood that burns long and steady.

lumber.name: Lumber
lumber.description: Sawn boards. Needs a saw mill.
lumber.note: Sawn boards. Placeholder until the saw mill exists (Dave 2026-10-20: logs become lumber at a saw mill).

plank_chest_kit.name: Plank chest
plank_chest_kit.description: Boards and twine for a stronger storage chest, ready to set down.

plank_chest.name: Plank chest
plank_chest.description: A plank chest for storing more things.
plank_chest.note: Comes after the saw mill. Same row state as the woven chest (6); Art gives it a plank look.

iron_ingot.name: Iron ingot
iron_ingot.description: A bar of smelted iron. Placeholder until smelting exists.

steel_ingot.name: Steel ingot
steel_ingot.description: A bar of steel. Placeholder until smelting exists.

iron_pickaxe.name: Iron pickaxe
iron_pickaxe.description: An iron head on a hardwood handle. One blow breaks one stone off a boulder.

steel_pickaxe.name: Steel pickaxe
steel_pickaxe.description: A steel head on a hardwood handle. One blow breaks one stone off a boulder, and it lasts longest.

soil.name: Soil
soil.description: A shovelful of dark earth, dug from the ground.

clay.name: Clay
clay.description: A heavy, sticky shovelful of clay.

gravel.name: Gravel
gravel.description: A shovelful of small stones and grit.

wooden_bowl.name: Wooden bowl
wooden_bowl.description: A bowl hollowed from a bolt of wood. Carries a little water.

clay_pot.name: Clay pot
clay_pot.description: A fired pot of clay. Holds three litres of water.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.description: A wooden bucket bound with cord. Holds eight litres of water.

waterskin.name: Waterskin
waterskin.description: A skin bag sewn shut. Holds a day's drink and little weight.

rope.name: Rope
rope.description: Twisted cordage, strong enough to haul and to lash a frame.

stone_spade.name: Stone spade
stone_spade.description: A wooden spade shod with a flat stone blade. Digs deeper than bare wood and lasts longer.

iron_spade.name: Iron spade
iron_spade.description: A spade with an iron blade.

steel_spade.name: Steel spade
steel_spade.description: A spade with a steel blade.

sewing_needle.name: Sewing needle
sewing_needle.description: A needle carved from bone. For sewing hide and cloth.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: A hide pack with straps. Worn on the back, it lets you carry more.

energy_bar.name: Energy bar
energy_bar.description: Nuts, dried fruit and herbs pressed into a cake. Quick energy that wears on your fitness.

herbal_tea.name: Herbal tea
herbal_tea.description: Mint leaves steeped and drunk. A small lift of energy.

magic_tonic.name: Magic tonic
magic_tonic.description: A shimmering draught. A great lift of energy.

remains.name: Remains
remains.description: A fallen traveller and the pack they carried.

rotten_food.name: Rotten food
rotten_food.description: Food that has gone bad. Do not eat it.

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.description: A bitter remedy that settles a sick stomach. Placeholder until healers and herb cures exist.

stomach_tea.name: Stomach tea
stomach_tea.description: A folk remedy: mint and chamomile steeped for a sick stomach. Settles vomiting and the runs.

chamomile_tea.name: Chamomile tea
chamomile_tea.description: A folk remedy: chamomile flowers steeped in water. Calms the stomach and helps you sleep.

willow_bark_tea.name: Willow bark tea
willow_bark_tea.description: A folk remedy: bitter willow bark steeped for pain and fever. It also eases a sick stomach a little.

grass_skirt.name: Grass skirt
grass_skirt.description: Woven grass hung from the waist. Barely warm, and it rots quickly.

grass_cloak.name: Grass cloak
grass_cloak.description: A cloak of woven grass over the shoulders. Keeps a little wind off.

fibre_sandals.name: Fibre sandals
fibre_sandals.description: Soles of twisted fibre tied to the foot.

hide_cloak.name: Hide cloak
hide_cloak.description: A wrapped animal hide. Warm, and it sheds rain.

hide_boots.name: Hide boots
hide_boots.description: Hide wrapped and stitched around the foot.

hide_hood.name: Hide hood
hide_hood.description: A close hood of hide with the hair turned in.
